csv_project_name: DB for New Highway Storage Building
csv_scope_of_work: Sealed Bids will be received by Grundy County, Illinois for Highway Storage Building and is further described as follows: To design and construct a new storage building approximately 90 x 170 on the current GCHD grounds. The building shall be used for storage of GCHD vehicles and equipment and shall be constructed of metal with a concrete floor and overhead sectional doors. Other design features required are floor drains, concrete aprons, fire suppression and landscaping. Inside features include Under Floor Plumbing, Mechanical, and Electrical.
